description: Statically build a source-backed standalone interface and workload privilege baseline without probing deployments, separating minimum-required from component-default privileges across network, device, runtime, driver, IPC, fabric, RBAC, and host surfaces.

history.notes: Restrict Stage A to static source, default configuration, specification, and documentation analysis; retain probe classification only as a later manual-validation hint
Add workload/profile-scoped runtime privilege contracts that distinguish evidence-backed minimum requirements from component-default requests
Add accelerator device, Unix socket, shared-memory/IPC, runtime-hook, driver/kernel, fabric, and privileged-agent interface discovery and schema support
Separate standalone component mapping from platform integration analysis and add the completeness gate and normative baseline schema
